title: My concerts
intro: The concerts you went to, year by year.

errors.dayInvalid: That day does not exist in the chosen month.

community.addHint: Were you at one that isn't listed? Add it: it stays pending until other people confirm it.

dialog.dateHint: The exact date: that's how the concert is recognised.

errors.duplicate: That concert already exists: join it instead.
errors.implausible: The date doesn't match the artist's years of activity.
errors.notAllowed: Adding concerts needs an account at least 7 days old with a verified email.

errors.suspended: Your account has an active social suspension.
